text: Toshe Chaosrender, a member of the Earthen Ring, is a taunka quest giver found in the Shimmering Expanse area within Vashj'ir where he requests the aid of the adventurers with his battle against Zin'jatar naga in the area. He initially sails to the area with the Alliance aboard Voldrin's Hold. He later appears in the Twilight Highlands where he is battling minions of the Old Gods.
Tormented Soulpriest is a draenei ghost quest giver found in the Auchenai Crypts.
Torias is a draenei found walking among a small group viewing the Exodar Holographic Emitters within the Vault of Lights in the Exodar.
Tormented Protector is an ancient protector found in the Firelands.
Torjar's Bane appears out of the mists during Parental Mastery.

The Torjari Pit is an old mogu sacrificial site that lies in ruins in the southwestern Valley of the Four Winds, just to the northeast of Nesingwary's Safari. Dragon turtles are found all over the area and Jonn-Dar is occasionally found here as well. Deep below in the pit is the Lair of the Beast. The old mogu empire used to toss unruly people into the waters below.
Tortured Spirits are shades located in the Den of Sorrow in the Jade Forest. Anduin Wrynn can cleanse their soul revealing that they are jinyu spirits in Rest in Peace.
Torgo the Elder is a human death knight found in Icecrown Citadel. He is helping in the final push against the Lich King.
__NOTOC__ Torrention is a water elemental found inside Thelgen Rock of the Wetlands after collecting Thelgen Seismic Record.
Tortoise Flank is meat collected from Pearly Tortoise in Pearl Lake of the Jade Forest. They're required in Road Rations as a food source while the SI:7 stays in the Pearlfin Village.
A Torn Page is ripped from the Curious Text at on the altar at the southeast end of the Valley of Emperors in central Kun-Lai Summit.
Tormented Ghosts are wraiths located in Brawl'gar Arena and Bizmo's Brawlpub as part of the Dark Summoner encounter.
Tortos is the fourth boss encounter in the Throne of Thunder and the first part of the Forgotten Depths wing of the raid.
The Torso of the Chamberlain can be found at various locations in the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder.

The Torn Zandalari Journal is a rare drop from Zandalari trolls in Za'Tual, the Beast Pens, and the Conqueror's Terrace on the Isle of Thunder. Looting this book is one of the requirements of the Pandaria quest achievement Zandalari Library Card.
Tormented Skyscreamer is a skyscreamer located in Za'Tual on the Isle of Thunder. It cannot be attacked.
Toron Rockhoof is a tauren Blacksmithing vendors located at the Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal.

__NOTOC__ Tosamina is an orc located at the orphanage in the Drag of Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, Orphan Matron Battlewail and Tosamina are keeping the orphans safe within the orphanage and the door locked tight. They're ready to fight anyone that attempts to enter.
__NOTOC__ Torik-Ethis is a rare mantid found in the Forbidden Jungle in Krasarang Wilds. Torik-Ethis is a pandarian champion.
__NOTOC__ Tormar Frostgut is a magnataur who appears after planting the Hardpacked Explosive Bundle at Frostgut's Altar in Garm in the Storm Peaks.
Tormented Initiates are jinyu found in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Tormented Villagers are human ghosts located at Admiral Taylor's Garrison in the Spires of Arak.
Toshi is a pandaren located at the Zouchin Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Torgg Flexington is a garrison blueprints vendor found in Warspear in Ashran.
__NOTOC__ The Tormented Armament will create a weapon suitable for your spec when used.
A Torn Card is an Inscription skill-up item. Repairing it will yield either a Bent Card or an Unbendable Card.
A Torn Knapsack is a Tailoring skill-up item. Repairing it will yield either a Heavy Duty Knapsack or an Rugged Knapsack.
A Torn Voodoo Doll is an Enchanting skill-up item. Repairing it will yield either an Anguished Voodoo Doll or a Frightening Voodoo Doll.
Torm Ironfur is a tauren auctioneer located at the Warspear in Ashran.
Torment Ender's Chestguard is a quest reward from Set Them Free.
__NOTOC__ Toria's Perseverance is a world drop from level 98 - 102 mobs.
__NOTOC__ Toria's Unseeing Eye drops from Roltall in Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
__NOTOC__ Torok Bloodtotem's Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Tormented Leggings is a token that is used to create a Legs-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Tormented Treads is a token that is used to create a Feet-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Tormented Girdle is a token that is used to create a Waist-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Tormented Bracers is a token that is used to create a Wrist-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Tormented Gauntlets is a token that is used to create a Hands-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Tormented Spaulders is a token that is used to create a Shoulder-slot armor suitable for a character's armor class.
Tormented Guardians is an achievement earned from defeating the listed bosses in the Emerald Nightmare on any difficulty.
Torn Invitation is found in the following places: *the Glimmering Treasure Chest at the end of the Withered Army Training scenario *Nightfallen Hoard

Torvald the Defiant is a vrykul king trapped in his own corpse in Stormheim. The vrykul mystics cursed Torvald for defying him, striking his name from history and marking his grave with a sign called "He Who Shall Not Be Named". Known as the Nameless King, adventurers who find his grave can summon his corpse to battle him. If defeated, the curse is broken and Torvald's spirit rises from his body. He then gives adventurers his everlasting thanks as he rises to the Halls of Valor.
Toschayju is a Blizzard employee and Community Manager for the EU World of Warcraft [http://eu.battle.net/wow/en/forum/ forums].
__NOTOC__ Torrentius is a water elemental found at the Isle of the Watchers in Azsuna.
Toryl is a vrykul located at Jandvik in Suramar. She was impersonated by Tidemistress Sashj'tar.
Torn Fin Coastrunners are murlocs located in Western Strand in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Torn Fin Muckdwellers are murlocs located in Western Strand in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Tortollans are a race of turtle-like humanoids native to Zandalar. Some have left the isle to explore other areas, such as Kul Tiras. Tortollans first appeared in Hearthstone, where they lived in Un'Goro Crater.
The Torn Journal Page is mined from Leystone Deposits in the Broken Isles.
Leatherworkers can repair this item to create an Gleaming Bracers of the First War.
__NOTOC__ Torvald is a vrykul located in the Outcast's Hovel in Vrekt in Stormheim. He is the son of God-King Skovald.
__NOTOC__ Torturer Relyn is a felborne located in the Crimson Thicket in Suramar. He serves Lexera.
Torn Shal'dorei Silk is provided as an objective for Mending the Filter. Wanted by Deucus Valdera, the silk was mended by Leyweaver Erenyi.
Tormented Shivarra is a shivarra located at the Fel Hammer. She recruits the shivarra troops.
Tormenting Orbs are guardian eyes located in the Vault of the Wardens.
Tortured Prisoners are saberon located in Fang'rila in Tanaan Jungle.
Tormented Ritualists are inquisitors located in Antoran Wastes.
Torturer of the Inquisition is an inquisitor located in the Temple of the Jade Serpent.
Tormented Souls are human souls located at the Chapel Yard in Netherstorm. When aggroed, they will transform into Kirin'Var Ghosts.
Tormented Fragments are located in the Tomb of Sargeras as a part of the Demonic Inquisition encounter.
Torn Paintings drop from sethrak mobs in the Serpent's Maw in Vol'dun.
Torn Fragments of Cloth are looted from an Ancient Elven Chest in Val'sharah.
Tortollan Seekers (or just Seekers) is a faction located in Zuldazar on Zandalar and Stormsong Valley on Kul Tiras. A small group is also located in Exile's Reach.
Tortollan Travelers are tortollans located in Anyport in Drustvar and in underwater ruins in western Zuldazar.
Torn Screamers are banshees that roam around Northdale in the Eastern Plaguelands.
__NOTOC__ Tort Jaw is a dragon turtle located at Fizzsprings Resort in Tiragarde Sound.
Tortollan Pilgrimage Scroll is looted from chests in Kul Tiras and Zandalar.
__NOTOC__ Tormented Dryads are dryads located in Ash'theran in Val'sharah.
Tortollan Traders are tortollans located at Backwater Beach in Zuldazar.
The Torn Fabric of Reality drops from Kil'jaeden in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Tortollan Seekers are tortollans found in Little Tortolla in Dazar'alor and in Zuldazar.
Torra is a vulpera child that follows Nala around the Vulpera Hideaway in Vol'dun.
The Tortollan Seekers Commendation is automatically consumed and provides the amount of reputation shown in its tooltip with the Tortollan Seekers.

Tortaka Tribesmen are tortollans guarding the Tortaka Refuge in Vol'dun. Some unarmed tribesmen can be freed from Jungleweb Victim webs at the Terrace of the Fang. After completion of Wrath of the Tiger, armored tribesmen can be found standing guard in and around the Temple of Kimbul. They are present during Faction Assaults of Vol'dun and Zuldazar.

Tortaka Refugees are tortollans located in the Tortaka Refuge in Vol'dun. One can be seen at the eastern end of Darkwood Shoal, being entranced by Songstress Nahjeen with [https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267822/nahjeens-song Nahj'een's Song]. After completion of Wrath of the Tiger, refugees can also be found inside the Temple of Kimbul.
__NOTOC__ Torka is a tortollan quest giver located at the Tortaka Refuge in Vol'dun.

__NOTOC__ Tortaka Refuge is a small camp of the Tortaka tortollans located atop a small isle on the northeastern coast of Vol'dun. The Tortaka retreated here after being forced out of their home village at the nearby Darkwood Shoal by the Stormcoil naga.
Tortollan Scrolls drop from Nazeshi Tempest-Wielders in Zuldazar.

Tortollan Slaves are tortollan pilgrims from Nazmir that have been captured by the Faithless sethrak and are seen being auctioned off by Faithless Dealers at two of the slave markets in the Slithering Gulch in Vol'dun. If the corresponding Faithless Dealer is killed, the tortollans will casually walk away to freedom.
Torrentus is a large water elemental located at the Murloc Shoals in Suramar. The elemental was summoned by Blargrrrl.
Tormented Priestesses are night elf ghosts located in the Wailing Halls in the Tomb of Sargeras.
The Tortollan Seekers Supplies is a quest reward from Baubles from the Seekers.
Tormented Rangers are banshees located at the Windrunner Spire of Ghostlands during Lament of the Highborne (quest).
__NOTOC__ Tortollan Hardshells are tortollans located in Dazar'alor and Zuldazar and at Seekers' Vista in Stormsong Valley.
Tortollan Pilgrims are tortollans located in Nazmir and Zuldazar.
Tortollan Sacrifices are deceased tortollans located in Nazmir.
Tortollan Tamers are tortollans located in Dazar'alor and Zuldazar.
Tortollan Younglings are tortollan children located in Zuldazar.
Tortollan Trader's Stock is a quest reward from Tortollan Seekers (quest). It is also a quest reward from world quests.
Tormented Magisters are spectres located in the Sunwell Plateau during The Fall of the Sunwell.
Tornsail Skull Cracker is a quest reward from Out With the Old Boss.
Torn Spirits are mogu ghosts located on the expedition isles.
__NOTOC__ Torraske the Eternal is a saurolisk located in Warport Rastari in Zuldazar. Surounded by mogu, it has managed to kill three Kao-Tien Slavers.
Tortured Reefwalkers are coral ancients located in the Imperial Gardens in Nazjatar.
Tortured Protectorate Vanguard is an ethereal located at Protectorate Watch Post in Netherstorm. Before succumbing to his wounds, he is found by Commander Ameer.
Tortolla's Eggs are eggs located at Ashen Lake in Mount Hyjal. They are being corrupted by Deep Corruptors and hatch into Children of Tortolla.
Torn Journal Page #7 is provided by Left while on Spies to the Left and Right.
Torus is a titanic watcher encountered by Alliance and Horde champions on Un'gol Ruins.

Torkhan is a tauren located in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. His wandering cycle comprises of watching the waterfall, going to wave at Tatepi, visiting the campfire with the shaman trainers, saluting to Kaja, then asking her a question, eventually going back to the waterfall, repeating his cycle.
Torn Pages of "The Curse of Stone" are looted from the Corrupted Chest after defeating Alleria Windrunner in the Vision of Stormwind or Thrall in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Torn Page of "The Final Truth" is obtained by completing a "Lost" area bonus objective within a Horrific Vision.
The Tortollan Shellraiser is a tortollan who manages the Reinforced Warshell at Zanj'ir Terrace in Nazjatar.
Tortollan Traveling Lantern is a quest reward from The Perfect Horse, of Course.
__NOTOC__ Torsheg is a mogu located at the Golden Stair in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Torment Cells are located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms and Uldum. They hold Captured Pandaren in Vale of Eternal Blossoms or Ramkahen Citizens in Uldum. In Vision of Stormwind, the cells appear too in the Slave District.
Tortollan Chests are three chests located in Stormsong Valley.
Tormented Kor'kron Annihilator is a scorpid located in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Torgok is an ogre located at the Ogre Ruins in Exile's Reach.
Tortollan Scroll Case ' is found at Covescale Rise in Zuldazar. It is revealed using the Scroll of Seeking.
The Tortollan Traveling Pack is found in the Dreadpearl Shallows in Zuldazar. It is revealed using the Scroll of Seeking.
Torghast Reconfiguration Rigs were to be created with Engineering (1).
Torghast Boss Loot drops from bosses in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Tormented Amalgamation is located in the Planes of Torment in during the Escape from the Maw.
Tortollan Villagers are dead tortollans located in Zuldazar and Nazmir.

Torment Chamber: Thrall is the week six quest in Torghast, first offered in the week of December 29. Like Torment Chamber: Jaina, this quest takes place in a special wing of Torghast, accessed via the Wayfinder, based on the Upper Reaches. Bolvar will offer the next quest, Signs of the Lion, in week seven, or twenty hours after this quest was completed.

Torment Chamber: Jaina is a special wing of Torghast, accessed via the Wayfinder during the quest of the same name. The wing is based strongly on level one of the Soulforges wing of the tower, and the same mechanics are present.
__NOTOC__ Tortured Soles are crafted with Leatherworking (1).
The Tormentor's Rod is provided as an objective for Rodent Removal.
Torturer's Keys drop from Vile Torturers at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown. They must be used to free captured Argent Hippogryph Riders in the area.
Torment of Torments is an Azerite trait for Discipline and Shadow priests. It doesn't appear to be available.
The Tormentor's Notes are found on the corpse of Subject 638, found at near the Stygian Incinerator at Zovaal's Cauldron in the Maw. As Maw lore, Ve'nari will accept it for reputation.
Torgok's Reagent Pouch drops from Torgok in Ogre Ruins in Exile's Reach.
Tortured Scouts are blood elves, draenei, and humans located in cages at Aldur'thar: The Desolation Gate in Icecrown.
Tormenters are a type of creature introduced in Shadowlands.

The Antechamber of Torghast, Tower of the Damned is where players first enter the tower. From the antechamber, they have access to the six primary wings, of which two are available any given week: *Skoldus Hall *Fracture Chambers *The Soulforges *Coldheart Interstitia *Mort'regar *The Upper Reaches In their first visit, they will discover The Forgotten Key, which unlocks access to the Runecarver's Oubliette, somewhere else in the tower. Later on, they will gain access to the Twisting Corridors.
The chest of Torture Implements is found at ( in local coordinates) in the back of the Extractor's Sanatorium of the Tremaculum in the northwestern portion of the Maw.
Tormenter Overlords are located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Toss a Seed to Your Hunter... is an exploration achievement earned by tossing A Faintly Glowing Seed at Gwynceirw, during or after combat with the mire boggart.
The Torturer's Hovel is a cave located in the Soulstained Fields of the Beastwarrens in the Maw.

__NOTOC__ The Tortured Amalgamation is a shade located in the Fracture Chambers in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Created from a group of Night Elf Souls that were imprisoned within the tower, they were saved by the Maw Walker, who used the Soulkeeper Crystal to absorb them in order to weaken and defeat the shade.
The Tormented Greataxe is created with a Munificent Armament.
The Tormented Longbow is created with a Munificent Armament.
The Tormented Polearm is created with a Munificent Armament.
The Tormented Scepter is created with a Munificent Armament.
The Tormented Warmace is created with a Munificent Armament.
The Torq of Noble Primacy is created with a Munificent Choker.
The Torq of Soothing Waters can be created with a Turbulent Choker or Shared Turbulent Choker.

Tormentors of Torghast is an event that runs every two hours in the Maw. Fill the bar by defeating the attacking enemies (and elites), then defeat the boss that spawns for rewards. Killing all fifteen bosses grants the achievement Minions of the Cold Dark.

The Tormentor's Cache drops from Tormentors of Torghast bosses in the Maw once a week. It contains: *Warped Phantasma *50x Soul Cinders *200x Stygia *+250 reputation with Ve'nari *+250 reputation with Death's Advance *Chain of Bahmethra (rarely) *Conduits *Korthian armor *Cosmetic cloaks including Beastcaller's Skull Crescent, Borrowed Eye Crescent
Tormented Krokul are krokul located at the Pits of Punishment in Antoran Wastes.

Tossaways are trinkets that all smart goblins carry with them and throw behind them as protection from the invisible creature known as the Uninvited Guest, which always stops to count coins dropped on the ground. Tossaways look like shiny, painted-gold discs stamped with the grinning face of the first trade prince—a visual copy of the ancient goblin currency known as galleons. They were invented by Slixi Boompowder, whose husband Klaxz was the Uninvited's first known victim.

Torglluun is a shade located in The Rift of Maw, where Cyrixia normally spawns at Ruin's Cradle. See the Rift article for information on how to access the Rift. The shade always drops Nilganihmaht's Runed Band and occasionally drops the Bottled Shade Heart and the Orb of Enveloping Rifts. The shade is also required for Conquering Korthia, and grants 5% progress toward Shaping Fate.
Torture Device Parts can be obtained from the following chests in Korthia and the Maw: *Helsworn Chest *Mawsworn Cache *Spectral Bound Chest

__NOTOC__ Tormented Demolishers are charred behemoths that occasionally spawn in the Scholar's Den and inside the Caverns of Contemplation of Korthia. Defeat them and the actual rare-elite Kroke the Tormented may spawn.
Torment Golem are Mawsworn constructs located in the Adamant Vaults in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Tormentor's Tango is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating Soulrender Dormazain after /taunting Garrosh Hellscream before combat begins and avoiding all Torment impacts in the Sanctum of Domination on Normal difficulty or higher.

Tortured Attendants are attendants located in the Seeker's Quorum of Korthia. Caretaker Kah-Than wants the Maw Walker to free six of them in Rescued from Torment, part of the Chains of Domination campaign.
The Torn Bet Voucher is looted from Grandmaster Vole's Disgruntled Gift.
Tormented Shadowcleft Boots are dropped by Soulrender Dormazain in the Sanctum of Domination.
Tormented Rack Fragment is dropped by Painsmith Raznal in the Sanctum of Domination.

The Tormentor's Manacled Backplate is looted from Tormentor's Cache.
The Tormentor's Greatbelt drops from Mor'geth at Helgarde Keep in The Maw.
The Tormented Soul Harness drops from Mor'geth at Helgarde Keep in The Maw.

The Torment Chambers are a complex located on the eastern side of the mid-level Sanctum of Domination, accessible via a bridge from the central spire. The Torment Chambers area itself only consists of a stairwell surrounded by cells holding captive souls, with three paths in different directions: the southern leads to the Font of Fury overlooking Gorgoa (Soulrender Dormazain), the northern to the Penance of the Fallen King on the Sanctum's outer edge (Remnant of Ner'zhul), and the central to the Black Bellows, a corridor which turns north and leads to the Screaming Anvil (Painsmith Raznal).
Tortured Assistant's Bindings drop from Doctor Ickus in Plaguefall.

Torturer Alphonse is a torturer of the Scarlet Onslaught found in the basement of the barracks at New Hearthglen, in Dragonblight, working at what appears to be an Alchemy Lab. Despite his status as a vile torturer, he begs for his life when tortured by you. Before he finishes his monologue, he states that Perhaps he is reminiscing about his own torturing experiences.

The Tormented Banner of the Opportune was rewarded to all registered teams that complete under time the two dungeons within the Proving Grounds for the Mythic Dungeon International: The Great Push during Shadowlands Season 2.
Torn Rune-Embroidered Pouch is looted from Black Empire Coffers in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Torntusk Pendant is a quest reward from It's Ours Now (Horde).
__NOTOC__ Tormented Highborne are banshees located in the Ruins of Mathystra in Darkshore.
Torghast Ash Globe is sold by Griftah in the Broker's Den in Oribos.

Tormented Mawsteel Greatsword is looted from Domination Cache in Zereth Mortis.
The Tormented Emblem of Flame is created through the use of a Tormented Trinket.
The Tormented Fang of Gore is created through the use of a Tormented Trinket.

The Tormented Seal of Fortitude is created through the use of a Tormented Trinket.
The Torrential Lily drops from Alora Mistbreeze in Thaldraszus.

Totem-Caller Belt is a starting item for allied race shaman.

Torrential Downpour Gauntlets drops from Primal Tsunami in Halls of Infusion.

Totem of Infliction is an off-hand item and not a totem. It occasionally inflicts damage to the attacker. It looks like a white skull with horns.
Totemic Clan Ring is a quest reward from Revenge of Gann (2).

The Totem of Spirits is a soul-collecting totem used to collect the souls of the enraged elementals so that Earthmender Torlok can question them on what has gone wrong: *Scorned Spirit of Air *Scorned Spirit of Earth *Scorned Spirit of Fire *Scorned Spirit of Water

Touch of Inspiration drops from Reliquary of Souls in the Black Temple.

Totems were formerly shaman-specific relics. Relics replace ranged weapons for death knights, druids, paladins, and shamans, and typically give significant bonuses to a single spell rather than a general stat bonus of ranged weapons. With 3.0.2, all Relic totems had a note saying , meaning one could safely deposit the items that were required to cast your totems (as in, the spells, the items you got from quests) in your bank, freeing up 4 inventory slots. This was however removed in Patch 4.0.1, making totem spells not require a totem.
Totemic Focus is a shaman talent located on tier 2 of the Restoration tree.
The Touch of Zanzil is the 3rd quest in the Mathias and the Defias quest chain.

The shaman Totem Bar was released in patch 3.2.0. The Totem Bar was displayed in the bottom left corner of the screen, where pet bars are normally found for Hunters and Warlocks. The bar consisted of up to six buttons, five of which could be changed via drop menu. There were four buttons, one for each element (in order: Air Totems, Water Totems, Earth Totems, Fire Totems). Upon level 30 shamans could learn the first "set spell" (Call of the Elements (Wrath Classic); the other spells were: Call of the Ancestors and Call of the Spirits).
